name: What is the average cost of a full kitchen remodel in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a full kitchen remodel in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a full kitchen remodel in the Bay Area varies widely due to factors like kitchen size, material selections (e.g., custom cabinets vs. semi-custom, high-end appliances), and structural changes. While costs can range significantly, a full remodel typically starts from approximately $60,000 and can exceed $150,000 for high-end projects. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to align with your budget and vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: The average cost of a full kitchen remodel in the Bay Area can range from approximately $60,000 to over $150,000, depending on size, materials, and scope.
